result_text:
`all_files.zip` now looks up and names its entries from the configured aspect names, so renaming an aspect in `config.json` no longer drops the zip or `git-history.zip`.

The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`, in the export block around line 641. The five hardcoded `aspect_*.txt` literals are replaced by a loop over the five scope aspects. Each entry name comes from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same helper that writes the loose files, so the names match by construction. The entry order is unchanged: main, test, generated, build and deployment, other.

The `reports` module compiles offline, and the `DataExport` test run passed. I did not run a full export with a renamed aspect, so the renamed case is verified by reading the code rather than by a run. Nothing is committed.
